svg.title: Board after the cost
svg.desc: Cost per month (cloud): / SMS fees: 10% of 30B messages x price per SMS -> most of the bill / Servers: 15 API + 3 queue + 45 store + ~10 senders = ~75 x price per instance / Total: SMS fees + servers (disks are in the instance price) / Proposed cut: push first, SMS as a fallback

text.tspan: SMS fees: 10% of 30B messages x price per SMS -> most of the bill
Servers: 15 API + 3 queue + 45 store + ~10 senders = ~75 x price per instance
Total: SMS fees + servers (disks are in the instance price)
Proposed cut: push first, SMS as a fallback
